result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but there are horizontal scrolling/clipping problems in the category and restaurant carousels, plus icon-only favorite controls that may be hard to interpret for assistive technologies.

issues.description: Content in horizontally scrolling sections is cut off at the right edge: the Healthy category chip is partially visible and the third Fastest near you card is clipped, with the restaurant name shown as 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Add clear carousel affordances such as peek spacing, scroll indicators, or ensure cards fit within the viewport; avoid truncating primary labels like restaurant names.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons on restaurant cards are icon-only and appear to rely on visual recognition alone.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen to favorites' and ensure sufficient touch target size and focus states.

issues.description: The lower Popular right now card is cropped by the bottom of the visible area, making the listing feel abruptly cut off before the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom spacing or adjust section sizing so partially visible cards look intentionally scrollable rather than accidentally clipped.
